notablePrerequisites:
Tolarian Sentinel does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
description:
Activate Tolarian Sentinel by paying {U}, discarding a card and tapping it, returning The One Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat each turn.
